evidence: CustomUnitLoader sets bg for queuedUnits animation and whenBuilding_* effects. Runtime checks bg/revertMetadata.bg, applies temporary conversion/playAnimation/rotateTo/triggerAction, stores isWhenBuildingCannotMove in g, and zeros movement velocity if true.
Constructor sets both flags true. update clears i and fires CREATED after creation behavior hooks; later it clears h and fires COMPLETE_AND_ACTIVE.
LegAnimationBehavior computes movement deltas from current position/height/direction minus these fields, then refreshes them. du() and position reset initialize them from current unit state.
The timer decrements when positive and is reset from autoTriggerCooldownTime after a trigger fires.
